cases.scenario: Three predeclared load strata with known randomized repair assignment and paired hidden potential outcomes.
Observational assignment is supplied to the P0 randomized estimator.
One stratum has no control units, so positivity fails.
Pre-assignment baseline becomes available after assignment time.
Outcome is not available by the declared analysis as-of time.
Outcome is observed before the preregistered follow-up horizon.
Oracle potential outcomes are altered after estimation; point estimate remains unchanged and oracle scoring detects inconsistency.
Duplicate asset/engine randomization unit is included twice.
A stratum has fewer than two units in one arm and variance is not estimable.
Exact randomization enumeration exceeds the bounded v0.1 unit limit.
